# DEC-02: Phone orders join the first phase

## Context
DEC-01 kept phone orders on the order sheet. On 2026-10-17 the client owner said the small customers who phone in are growing, and asked to include them now (your notes of the call; logs/larkspur-ceramics/decisions/DEC-01.md).

## Options
- Keep DEC-01: email purchase orders only, phone orders later.
- Include phone orders now: one place for every order, more to map in the plan.

## Decision
Phone orders join the first phase, next to purchase orders that arrive by email.
